datom_probe.driver:
(ns backdesk.datom-probe
 (:require [datom] [datom.profile :as profile] [reception.procedures.desk :as desk]))
(def schema [{:db/ident :hotel/id :db/valueType :db.type/string :db/unique :db.unique/identity}
             {:db/ident :hotel/property :db/valueType :db.type/string :db/index true}
             {:db/ident :hotel/kind :db/valueType :db.type/string :db/index true}])
(def query '[:find ?id :in $ ?property :where [?e :hotel/property ?property]
             [?e :hotel/kind "conversation"] [?e :hotel/id ?id]])
(doseq [size [100 1000]]
 (let [conn (datom/connect schema)
       records (mapv (fn [i] {"id" (str "conversation:" i) "kind" "conversation"
                              "property" "hotel:probe" "title" (str "Guest " i)}) (range size))]
  (try
   (datom/transact! conn (mapv (fn [[i row]] {:db/id (- 0 (+ i 1)) :hotel/id (get row "id")
                          :hotel/property "hotel:probe" :hotel/kind "conversation"})
                         (map-indexed (fn [i row] [i row]) records)))
   (let [database (datom/db conn)
         snapshot {:db database :now 1793000000000 :world {"entities" (into {} (mapv (fn [e] [(get e "id") e]) records))}}
         _ (desk/find-guests snapshot "hotel:probe" {"scope" "all"})
         started (erlang/monotonic_time :microsecond)
         page (desk/find-guests snapshot "hotel:probe" {"scope" "all"})
         elapsed (- (erlang/monotonic_time :microsecond) started)
         query-report (profile/analyze query database "hotel:probe")]
    (assert (= 40 (count (:rows page))))
    (assert (= size (:total page) (count (:result query-report))))
    (println "DATOM-PAGE-PROBE" {:conversations size :visible (count (:rows page))
             :query-result-rows (count (:result query-report)) :page-us elapsed
             :store (:store query-report)}))
   (finally (datom/close! conn)))))
datom_probe.scope: Actual desk/find-guests helper; minimal indexed schema and synthetic in-memory Datom connections; same unpaged query profiled separately.
datom_probe.interpretation: The requested work grows with candidate population despite a 40-row UI. Timings include warmup/cache differences and do not establish a latency-growth ratio.

timestamp_probe.driver:
(ns backdesk.time-probe (:require [hotel.time :as time]))
(doseq [round [1 2]]
 (let [start (erlang/monotonic_time :microsecond)
       labels (mapv (fn [i] (time/label (+ 1793000000000 (* i 60000)))) (range 40))]
  (assert (= 40 (count labels)))
  (println "TIMESTAMP-PROBE" {:round round :labels (count labels)
    :elapsed-us (- (erlang/monotonic_time :microsecond) start)})))
timestamp_probe.interpretation: Actual hotel.time/label invokes date per label. First use includes initialization. This does not explain the previous four-minute app readiness timeout.
